definition: the opening in a wall where a door is
description: A woman in a pale blue dress arrives at an old stone house. A hand holding a bunch of keys opens the flap of a brass letterbox set into the stone wall. She then goes to a tall wooden double door and fits a key into it, working the lock. At a second, darker wooden door she pushes a huge iron key into the lock beside an iron bar and a padlock, turns it with both hands and lifts the bar clear. Finally she pulls both heavy leaves of the door apart and stands in the middle of the open stone opening they leave in the wall, with the sunlit courtyard behind her - a cypress tree, wisteria on the wall and gravel underfoot.
